At this table, the team began with an owl, but Leo spoke up before the start went down. The client had owls in that window for years and wanted a change. Maya proposed a fox, and Priya settled on a cat, since regulars bring treats for the shop cat every day. Maya noted that the cat, Biscuit, sleeps in that window. Priya laid the start, Leo took the curly tail, and Maya and Tom built the sides and ears.

The trouble came in the middle. Leo noticed that nothing stood along the bottom right of the belly, so the run could not reach Maya's side. He laid that stretch, and Priya fixed the main break. A stray line running up the body was lifted. Near the end, the right ear peak needed closing, and Maya joined it to Tom's ear. With two minutes left, the team was still nudging joints.

When the start was pushed, 130 of 196 dominoes fell. Everyone said cat, but the blind judges guessed a blob, island, or sack.
